turns.query: Apportion ZIP code tabulation areas to counties for Puerto Rico, using the 2020 Census ZCTA-to-county relationship file. Every ZCTA-county part lying in those counties gets a row: the ZCTA, the county FIPS code, the county name, the land area of the part, and that area as a fraction of the ZCTA's total land area. Take the total over every county the ZCTA touches, including counties outside the area asked for.
